info.name: Tatiana Kaado - Threats, Vulnerabilities, Reports
info.description: Tatiana Kaado – Run in order after database.seed and run_all.py. Login requests save role tokens; creation requests save IDs. Missing-resource cases use a nonexistent ID where supported, otherwise an unknown child route. CVSS zero maps to Low; resolved_at uses ISO timestamps.
